summary: GM Financial Automobile Leasing Trust 2026-2 filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement for a term asset-backed securitization of auto leases. The trust will issue seven tranches of notes totaling approximately $1.25 billion: Class A-1 ($167.18M at 3.831%), A-2-A ($300M at 4.12%), A-2-B ($141.25M floating), A-3 ($441.25M at 4.30%), A-4 ($82M at 4.36%), Class B ($61.8M at 4.60%), and Class C ($57M at 4.70%) notes, plus a residual certificate, with a closing date of May 14, 2026. The registrant is the issuing entity; no special situation event is present. This is a routine ABS issuance, not a special situation.
